modules.source:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# The oscilloscope: capture, trigger, measure, draw, again. Each capture is twice the screen's
# width, so a trigger can be found in its first half; the samples are evenly spaced because the
# board's hardware paces them, while this code runs from the page's timer and never waits.

import array
import time

import lvgl as lv

from probe import FULL_SCALE_MV, probe

POINTS = 250              # on the screen: 10 divisions
CAPTURE = 2 * POINTS      # per capture: room to find a trigger
TIMEBASES = [0.25, 1, 5, 20]  # ms per division
INPUTS = ["A0", "A1", "A2", "A3", "A4", "A5"]
TRIGGERS = ["Auto", "Rise", "Fall"]

_ui = None
_series = None
_samples = array.array("H", bytes(2 * CAPTURE))
_input = "A0"
_timebase = 1
_trigger = "Auto"
_running = True
_busy = False      # a capture is under way on the board
_rate = 0.0
_misses = 0
_frames = []       # times of the last frames drawn, for the frame rate


def _font(size):
    return getattr(lv, "font_montserrat_%d" % size)


def _style_matrix(matrix, accent):
    matrix.set_style_bg_opa(lv.OPA.TRANSP, 0)
    matrix.set_style_border_width(0, 0)
    matrix.set_style_pad_all(4, 0)
    matrix.set_style_pad_gap(6, 0)
    items = lv.PART.ITEMS
    matrix.set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(0x2A3444), items)
    matrix.set_style_bg_opa(lv.OPA.COVER, items)
    matrix.set_style_radius(8, items)
    matrix.set_style_border_width(0, items)
    matrix.set_style_shadow_width(0, items)
    matrix.set_style_text_color(lv.color_hex(0xFFFFFF), items)
    matrix.set_style_text_font(_font(16), items)
    matrix.set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(accent), items | lv.STATE.CHECKED)
    matrix.set_button_ctrl_all(lv.buttonmatrix.CTRL.CHECKABLE)
    matrix.set_one_checked(True)


def _rate_for(timebase):
    return POINTS * 1000 / (10 * timebase)


def _find_trigger(level, hysteresis):
    # The first crossing of level in the first half of the capture, after the signal was on the
    # other side by more than the hysteresis; None if there is none.
    rising = _trigger != "Fall"
    armed = False
    for i in range(CAPTURE - POINTS):
        value = _samples[i]
        if rising:
            if value < level - hysteresis:
                armed = True
            elif armed and value >= level:
                return i
        else:
            if value > level + hysteresis:
                armed = True
            elif armed and value <= level:
                return i
    return None


def _measure(low, high, level, hysteresis):
    # Frequency from the rising crossings over the whole capture, duty from the time above level.
    crossings = []
    armed = False
    above = 0
    for i in range(CAPTURE):
        value = _samples[i]
        if value >= level:
            above += 1
        if value < level - hysteresis:
            armed = True
        elif armed and value >= level:
            crossings.append(i)
            armed = False
    mv = lambda raw: raw * FULL_SCALE_MV / 65535 / 1000
    text = "min %.2f V   max %.2f V   Vpp %.2f V" % (mv(low), mv(high), mv(high - low))
    if len(crossings) >= 2 and high - low > 1300:
        frequency = (len(crossings) - 1) * _rate / (crossings[-1] - crossings[0])
        text += "\nfrequency %.1f Hz   duty %.1f %%" % (frequency, 100 * above / CAPTURE)
    else:
        text += "\nfrequency -   (no repeating signal)"
    return text


def _draw(first):
    for i in range(POINTS):
        _ui.scope.set_series_value_by_id(_series, i, _samples[first + i] * FULL_SCALE_MV // 65535)
    _ui.scope.refresh()


def _process():
    global _misses
    low, high = min(_samples), max(_samples)
    level = (low + high) // 2
    hysteresis = max((high - low) // 10, 300)
    first = _find_trigger(level, hysteresis) if high - low > 1300 else None
    if first is None:
        _misses += 1
        if _trigger != "Auto" and _misses < 10:
            _ui.status.set_text("%s: waiting for a trigger" % _input)
            return
        first = 0
    else:
        _misses = 0
    _draw(first)
    _ui.measures.set_text(_measure(low, high, level, hysteresis))
    now = time.ticks_ms()
    _frames.append(now)
    while len(_frames) > 10:
        _frames.pop(0)
    fps = ""
    if len(_frames) > 1:
        fps = "   %.0f frames/s" % (1000 * (len(_frames) - 1) / max(1, time.ticks_diff(now, _frames[0])))
    _ui.status.set_text("%s   %s%s" % (_input, "triggered" if _misses == 0 else "free running", fps))


def tick():
    # From the page's timer: start a capture, or collect a finished one and draw it.
    global _busy, _rate
    if not _running:
        return
    try:
        if not _busy:
            _rate = probe.start(_input, CAPTURE, _rate_for(_timebase))
            _busy = True
            _ui.scale.set_text("0.5 V/div    %g ms/div    %.0f samples/s" % (_timebase, _rate))
        elif probe.done():
            overruns = probe.read(_samples)
            _busy = False
            _process()
            if overruns:
                _ui.status.set_text("%d samples lost" % overruns)
    except OSError as error:
        _busy = False
        _ui.status.set_text("Error: %s" % error)


def _restart():
    # A new setting: the capture under way is left to finish and thrown away.
    global _busy, _misses
    if _busy:
        while not probe.done():
            time.sleep_ms(1)
        _busy = False
    _misses = 0


def input_changed(matrix):
    global _input
    index = matrix.get_selected_button()
    if 0 <= index < len(INPUTS):
        _restart()
        _input = INPUTS[index]


def time_changed(matrix):
    global _timebase
    index = matrix.get_selected_button()
    if 0 <= index < len(TIMEBASES):
        _restart()
        _timebase = TIMEBASES[index]


def trigger_changed(matrix):
    global _trigger
    index = matrix.get_selected_button()
    if 0 <= index < len(TRIGGERS):
        _trigger = TRIGGERS[index]


def run_clicked():
    global _running
    _running = not _running
    button = _ui.run_button
    button.get_child(0).set_text("Stop" if _running else "Run")
    button.set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(0xE0742F if _running else 0x2E9E6A), 0)
    if not _running:
        _ui.status.set_text("%s   stopped" % _input)


def generator_changed(switch):
    try:
        probe.generator(switch.has_state(lv.STATE.CHECKED))
    except OSError as error:
        _ui.status.set_text("Test signal: %s" % error)


def start(ui):
    global _ui, _series
    _ui = ui
    lv.screen_active().set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(0x121820), 0)
    chart = ui.scope
    series = chart.get_series_next(None)
    while series:  # the designer's sample series
        chart.remove_series(series)
        series = chart.get_series_next(None)
    chart.set_point_count(POINTS)
    try:
        chart.set_axis_range(lv.chart.AXIS.PRIMARY_Y, 0, FULL_SCALE_MV)
    except AttributeError:
        chart.set_range(lv.chart.AXIS.PRIMARY_Y, 0, FULL_SCALE_MV)
    chart.set_style_size(0, 0, lv.PART.INDICATOR)
    chart.set_style_line_width(2, lv.PART.ITEMS)
    chart.set_style_line_color(lv.color_hex(0x2A3444), lv.PART.MAIN)
    chart.set_style_border_width(0, 0)
    _series = chart.add_series(lv.color_hex(0x4CC38A), lv.chart.AXIS.PRIMARY_Y)
    for matrix, accent, choices, current in ((ui.input_buttons, 0x2E9E6A, INPUTS, _input),
                                             (ui.time_buttons, 0x2F6FDE, TIMEBASES, _timebase),
                                             (ui.trigger_buttons, 0x8A5CF6, TRIGGERS, _trigger)):
        _style_matrix(matrix, accent)
        matrix.set_button_ctrl(choices.index(current), lv.buttonmatrix.CTRL.CHECKED)
